chapter: Funerals, dances and the end of the parades
title: Acting out a funeral parade; poor pay at home; Armstrong's letter
summary: White acts out the whole parade, with the band playing hymns and blues, then says local pay is poor and relays Armstrong's letter about making money in the north.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope
